         5                  SENATOR SAMPSON:    Through you,

         6       Mr. President.  This Calendar Number 4 is a --

         7       basically, it's a loan disclosure bill which

         8       requires that a loan counseling disclosure

         9       rider be attached to contracts of sale either

        10       by a broker and/or attorney.

        11                  The last time this bill was on,

        12       there were certain issues that were raised

        13       with respect to this bill, and I went back and

        14       made certain changes as to revamp the

        15       definitions for residents, mortgagor division,

        16       loan counseling list, and residential real

        17       properties.

        18                  This bill would just apply to

        19       brokers and/or attorneys.  And the reason

        20       brokers are included in this bill is because

        21       when looking upstate, you have brokers who

        22       generate -- some of my colleague across the

        23       aisle raised it to me with respect to

        24       upstate -- you have brokers who generate these



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4440



         1       sorts of contracts.

         2                  In addition, at that point in time

         3       we talked about I had a hundred-mile radius in

         4       which Senator Bonacic talked about if there

         5       were -- we had to look at brokers maybe in

         6       New Jersey or Pennsylvania.

         7                  But that's why instead of using

         8       HUD, which is Housing and Urban Development,

         9       what I used is what we call the DHCR, Division

        10       of Housing and Community Renewal, which would

        11       include a list that is available of loan

        12       counselors which is available in all counties

        13       throughout the State of New York.

        14                  And in this addition also, Senator

        15       Bonacic talked about whether this would cause

        16       or create a cause of action.  This legislation

        17       does not create a private cause of action

        18       against an attorney and/or broker.

        19                  But what it does require is that

        20       the Department of Banking or the Attorney

        21       General can investigate those individuals who

        22       choose not to provide these disclosures and

        23       just provide a list to those who are

        24       interested who are not providing this



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4441



         1       information.  There is no punitive, there is

         2       no penalty.

         3                  And furthermore, just going with

         4       some statistics, there was one study of 40,000

         5       loans in Freddie Mac's affordable lending

         6       program that provided direct evidence that

         7       prepurchasing education and counseling reduced

         8       90-day delinquency rates by up to 34 percent.

         9       Furthermore, borrowers who participated in

        10       counseling had an overall default rate

        11       50 percent lower than noncounseled borrowers.

        12                  And this is basically a legislation

        13       to inform the prospective buyers that before

        14       they go in and meet with these financial

        15       mortgage brokers or these banks, at least they

        16       have a litany of questions that they can ask

        17       them and they really can't be duped.

        18                  Sometimes, you know, you go to

        19       these financial institutions, and they can

        20       sell -- you know, it's like the fox in the

        21       henhouse.  They're going to do whatever they

        22       can to sell you this mortgage but at the same

        23       time not provide you the necessary

        24       information.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

                                                         4442



         1                  So what we're saying is I want to

         2       educate the buyer before they go to these

         3       financial institutions so they are educated.

         4                  And furthermore, there was an issue

         5       between, you know, whether there was an

         6       individual who bought commercial property who

         7       was sophisticated in buying that.  But what I

         8       did, in defining the definition -- and

         9       residential means any residential property

        10       that has a commercial space or use.  Like if

        11       you have a commercial store or a supermarket

        12       on top of a six-unit home, at that point in

        13       time it's a mixed-use property, so therefore

        14       it would be covered in the definition of this

        15       bill.

        16                  So if there's any questions, I

        17       would --

        23       Senator DeFrancisco, on the bill.

        24                  SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:    And I want



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4443



         1       to thank Senator Sampson for taking some of

         2       the suggestions from this side of the aisle to

         3       modify the bill.

         4                  I just have a problem just with the

         5       bill in general, and this is what the problem

         6       is.  There was a time when you went to a

         7       closing and when you went to the closing you

         8       had a deed to be signed, a closing statement

         9       to be signed.  And people somehow got around

        10       the whole issue of whether it's a good idea to

        11       borrow money, whether it's a good idea that

        12       this is a good house, whether or not there's

        13       an inspection was done properly.  I don't know

        14       how people possibly did that in the past.

        15                  Well, over the last probably 20 to

        16       30 years, there's a new form at every closing.

        17       There's a new form every time you sign a

        18       contract:  a disclosure about this, a

        19       disclosure about that.

        20                  It was only last year, the last

        21       couple of years, a few years ago when the

        22       federal government was encouraging people to

        23       buy homes to the point where loans were given

        24       by banking institutions and organizations,



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4444



         1       Fannie Mae and the like, where they had no

         2       business whatsoever getting those loans.

         3                  So now we've turned to the total

         4       opposite.  Now we've got a crisis as far as

         5       housing is concerned, all these mortgages that

         6       defaulted.  So now we're going the total

         7       opposite.  Now everyone can't just go in and

         8       buy a house, whether they can afford it or

         9       not; now we're going to give loan counseling

        10       and information about loan counseling before

        11       they sign a contract.

        12                  I just think it's to the point

        13       where people have to make some judgments on

        14       their own.  And I think if you don't

        15       understand a mortgage or the loan terms, you

        16       really should know enough to get advice if you

        17       need advice, rather than have another form

        18       handed to you when you buy the house.

        19                  Which brings me to the other couple

        20       of points.  And that is an individual, a

        21       lawyer or a broker has to have an obligation

        22       here to hand out another form, just one more

        23       thing to make the closing more costly and to

        24       make it more difficult and onerous for anybody



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4445



         1       handling these types of deals.

         2                  In addition -- and I said it was a

         3       good idea, some of these changes -- Senator

         4       Sampson made sure there was no cause of action

         5       here that could possibly be done or that the

         6       transaction could not be set aside if this

         7       form wasn't given out.  That's terrific, and I

         8       think it's a great idea.

         9                  And the alternative is basically if

        10       you do this, don't provide these forms out,

        11       you then could be investigated by some state

        12       agency.  And if it's a repeated violation,

        13       then you could be, I guess, censured.  I guess

        14       the public could learn that you haven't handed

        15       these forms out.

        16                  I don't know what protection the

        17       public gets from that remedy, primarily

        18       because I don't think any lawyer would really

        19       lose any business or any broker would lose any

        20       business because the public is being told by

        21       some state agency that they did not hand out a

        22       form and they didn't do it repeatedly.

        23                  So I guess I just don't

        24       understand -- I don't believe in the need for



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4446



         1       this.  Buyers should have some basic

         2       intelligence and understand, should be able to

         3       ask questions of whomever they need.  And, you

         4       know, that's basically where I'm standing.

         5                  And the other point was that these

         6       loan counselors, we're basically I would think

         7       starting to generate a new business.  Maybe --

         8       I don't know if they're going to be licensed,

         9       required to be licensed or not.  And a new

        10       business when, in my judgment, it's really not

        11       necessary to make make-work businesses, it's

        12       necessary to support the ones that we

        13       currently have.  And you don't support them by

        14       making it more difficult to do business in our

        15       state.

        16                  So I'm going to vote no on this

        17       bill.  Thank you.

                                                         4447



         1                  SENATOR BONACIC:    Mr. President,

        23       Mr. President -- at which point in time I

        24       explained to them the gist of this bill and



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4448



         1       what we're trying to do.  And they were

         2       opposed.

         3                  But this morning I got a letter in

         4       support from the State Bar Association real

         5       estate division.  Because what I'm trying to

         6       do is not giving another responsibility and

        19       instead of doing everything on the back end,

        20       to try to do it on the front end so they can

        21       educate themselves and they can ask important

        22       questions that they need to when they fill out

        23       these documents and finally go to closing.

        24                  Thank you, Mr. President.

         8                  I guess the major point is for

         9       years people didn't need loan counseling.

        11       crisis was not caused by people not

        12       understanding the mortgages, the crisis was

        14       origination people that were pushing mortgages

        18       incentivized to go forward and try to get a

        19       house when they might not otherwise have even

        20       thought about it.  And that's what caused it.

        21                  And the remedy should be in other

        22       areas rather than requiring every single

        23       transaction from here on forward in the State

        24       of New York to require another form to be

                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4450



         1       handed out so that people understand.  They

         2       should know what they're doing before they go

         3       into it.

         4                  And if, after this crisis, people

         5       buying houses, if they're not aware that

         6       they've got to look into what they're getting

         7       into before they get into it, after all the

         8       publicity and all the heartache and all the

        10       them.

        11                  SENATOR SAMPSON:    And through

        12       you, Mr. President --

        16       with you, Senator DeFrancisco, that is why

        18       we have individuals who just go into things

        20                  And by educating them and asking

        21       them a few more questions when they go into

        22       these situations, I don't think that is too

        23       much of a burden.  Because we have seen the

        24       impact that has happened with respect to this



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

                                                         4451



         1       financial crisis and the destruction that it

         2       is causing, not only in New York State but

         3       throughout this country.

         4                  So what I'm saying is a little bit

         5       more information on the front end instead of

         6       back end will save us a lot more grief and

         8                  Thank you, Mr. President.
